basic_info.description: Fulton 555 is a modern collection of 139 junior one-, one-, two-bedroom condominiums and townhomes designed by Ian Birchall & Associates, located in the heart of Hayes Valley. Residence #223 is a south-facing 1 bedroom / 1 bath home featuring a spacious walk-in closet, and stylish eat-in kitchen. Other features include floor-to-ceiling windows, stainless steel Bosch appliances, modern cabinets, and hardwood floors throughout. The building's amenities include an onsite organic grocery, rooftop terrace, dog park, bicycle workstation, lobby attendant, and private lounge. Fulton 555 is centrally located, just steps from San Francisco's illustrious performing arts venues, serious foodie locales, trend-setting boutiques and stroll-able streets.
